scams.name: Florianópolis Hercílio Luz Airport (FLN) Taxi Mafia & Beach Transfer Overcharge
scams.description:
Florianópolis's Hercílio Luz Airport (FLN, 12 km from Centro) is South Brazil's main coastal arrival point and hosts a 2025 taxi-overcharge ecosystem common to Brazilian airports — amplified during peak summer (Dec–Mar) and Réveillon when tourist demand surges and unlicensed drivers flood the curb.

The 2025 scams: (a) FLN arrivals-curb 'Special Taxi' kiosks quoting R$150–R$300 to Centro / Lagoa da Conceição / Jurerê (real Uber R$50–R$120 depending on destination); (b) sign-holders posing as 'pousada transfer' agents intercepting tourists; (c) Uber driver cancel-and-recontract scam — same template as São Paulo / Rio; (d) 'beach circuit transfer R$400' bundle marked up vs DIY local-bus access; (e) 'meter broken' yellow taxi demands at hotel arrival with R$200+ flat-rate cash demand; (f) GIG-to-FLN airline-misdirection touts at GRU / GIG offering 'cheap flight package' to Floripa that turn out to be expired credits or Bolivian-airline fraud; (g) 'private driver to praia + lunch combo R$400' commission bundles (real Uber to Praia Mole R$30–R$60).

For travelers: (1) book Uber / 99 on airport Wi-Fi AFTER luggage — typical FLN to Centro R$50–R$80 (15 min); to Lagoa da Conceição R$70–R$100 (25 min); to Praia Mole R$80–R$120 (35 min); to Jurerê (north island) R$100–R$150 (40 min); (2) at FLN, meet driver at the designated 'Aplicativos' pickup zone signposted at terminal exit; (3) Ignore every 'Special Taxi' kiosk inside terminal quoting above R$150 to Centro; (4) the LOCAL BUS Florianópolis (Consórcio Fênix) connects FLN to TICEN central terminal at R$5.50 per person (40 min) — budget alternative; (5) for return to FLN, pre-book Uber the night before; (6) Don't hand a credit card to any taxi driver — pay in-app or cash only; (7) for the beach circuit (Mole / Joaquina / Galheta / Barra da Lagoa), local bus is R$5.50 each beach OR Uber R$30–R$60 between beaches; (8) DEATUR Florianópolis +55 48 3271 6390 (English available, R. Carlos Adolfo Wendhausen, 86). Book Uber or 99 on airport Wi-Fi AFTER you have your luggage — typical FLN to Centro R$50–R$80, Lagoa da Conceição R$70–R$100, Praia Mole R$80–R$120, Jurerê R$100–R$150. Meet driver at the signposted "Aplicativos" pickup zone. IGNORE every "Special Taxi" kiosk quoting above R$150. Budget alternative: Consórcio Fênix bus to TICEN at R$5.50 per person (40 min). Pre-book Uber the night before for return; never hand a credit card to any taxi driver. Save DEATUR Florianópolis +55 48 3271 6390 (English available).
scams.avoidance: Book Uber/99 on airport Wi-Fi: FLN-Centro R$50–R$80; Lagoa R$70–R$100 Meet driver at 'Aplicativos' signposted pickup zone OR Consórcio Fênix local bus FLN-TICEN R$5.50 (40 min) NEVER hand credit card to any taxi driver DEATUR +55 48 3271 6390 (English available)
scams.location: Hercílio Luz International Airport (FLN) arrivals, Centro / Lagoa da Conceição / Praia Mole / Jurerê transfer routes, FLN 'Special Taxi' kiosks, beach-zone hotel drop-offs
scams.tldr: Florianópolis Hercílio Luz Airport (FLN) "Special Taxi" kiosks quote R$150–R$300 to Centro / Lagoa / Jurerê (real Uber R$50–R$120); curb sign-holders pose as "pousada transfer" agents; "private driver + lunch combo R$400" bundles cover commission stops — the Consórcio Fênix bus to TICEN is R$5.50.

scams.name: Florianópolis Aluguel Temporada / Airbnb High-Season Cancel-and-Relist Fraud
scams.description:
Florianópolis accommodations spike 4–10× during peak summer (Dec–Mar) and Réveillon, and a 2025 cancel-and-relist plus phishing-site fraud ecosystem is widely documented across Brazilian traveler-community channels.

The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Instagram / Facebook 'aluguel de temporada Floripa' pages with stolen photos of luxury Jurerê / Praia Mole pousadas — tourist pays in advance via PIX, arrives, finds no property; names a specific recurring phishing site; (b); (c) WhatsApp 'private Praia Mole apartment for January R$8,000/week' demanding 100% PIX upfront — irreversible Brazilian payment; (d) Praia Brava / Jurerê 'beachfront' listings actually 500 m–1 km inland with no view; (e) on-arrival bait-and-switch from confirmed unit to inferior; (f) 'cleaning deposit R$600 cash on arrival' that never returns; (g) 'mandatory parking fee R$200/night' for street parking that's free; (h) Mega Model fake 'modeling scout' approach on beach offering 'free week accommodation' in exchange for photoshoot — actually trafficking risk.

For travelers: (1) for Florianópolis in peak season (Dec–Mar) and Réveillon, BOOK 6–9 MONTHS AHEAD via Booking.com or established hotel chains; reputable: Hotel Pousada dos Sonhos (Jurerê), Pousada do Pero (Centro), Costa Norte Ingleses Hotel, Slaviero Hotel; Avoid Airbnb peak-season Floripa (cancel-and-relist documented across Brazil); (2) Never PIX-transfer to Instagram / WhatsApp 'aluguel temporada' sellers — irreversible Brazilian payment system; only platform-secure payment; (3) cross-reference any pousada / apartment name on Google Maps + Tripadvisor BEFORE booking — fake listings have no independent online footprint; (4) for 'beachfront' verify via Google Maps satellite view — Jurerê / Praia Brava / Mole listings claim 'beachfront' but many are 500 m–1 km inland; (5) refuse 'cleaning deposit cash on arrival' — request via platform only; (6) refuse 'mandatory parking R$200/night' for street parking; (7) Avoid 'Mega Model scout' beach-approach offers entirely — see separate scam below; (8) DEATUR Florianópolis +55 48 3271 6390 for booking-fraud denuncia within 48 hours; (9) for the budget-conscious in peak season, basing in less-stressed Centro (with Uber to beaches) is half the cost of beach-zone Jurerê / Praia Mole rentals. For peak season (Dec–Mar) and Réveillon, BOOK 6–9 months ahead via Booking.com or established hotel chains — reputable: Hotel Pousada dos Sonhos (Jurerê), Pousada do Pero (Centro), Costa Norte Ingleses Hotel, Slaviero Hotel. Avoid Airbnb peak-season Floripa entirely (cancel-and-relist documented across Brazil). NEVER PIX-transfer to Instagram or WhatsApp "aluguel temporada" sellers — irreversible Brazilian payment. Verify "beachfront" claims via Google Maps satellite view; refuse all "cleaning deposit cash on arrival" or "mandatory parking R$200/night" demands. DEATUR +55 48 3271 6390 for booking-fraud denuncia within 48 hours.
scams.avoidance: Peak season: book 6–9 months ahead via Booking.com / hotel chains Reputable: Pousada dos Sonhos, Pousada do Pero, Costa Norte Ingleses, Slaviero AVOID Airbnb peak-season; NEVER PIX-transfer to Instagram/WhatsApp sellers Cross-reference name on Google Maps + Tripadvisor DEATUR +55 48 3271 6390 for chargeback denuncia within 48 hours
scams.location: Florianópolis Airbnb listings (Booking.com, Hotels.com, Airbnb), high-season window (Dec–Mar peak summer + Réveillon), 'aluguel temporada' Instagram / WhatsApp dealers, fake-listing phishing sites
scams.tldr: Peak-summer (Dec–Mar) and Réveillon Florianópolis accommodation faces Instagram/WhatsApp "aluguel temporada Floripa" PIX-deposit fraud with stolen luxury-pousada photos, Airbnb cancel-and-relist at 3–5× the original price, and "beachfront" listings actually 500 m–1 km inland.

scams.name: Florianópolis 'Mega Model' Beach-Recruit Scam at Praia Mole / Jurerê
scams.description:
Florianópolis hosts a documented 2025 "modeling scout" beach-recruitment scam targeting young female tourists with promises of "free accommodation + photoshoot" that actually carry trafficking and sexual-exploitation risk per Brazilian Federal Police anti-trafficking advisories.

The 2025 scam pattern: (a) well-dressed individuals (often male, sometimes pairs) approach female tourists (typically 18–30, sometimes travelers' adult daughters) at Praia Mole / Praia Brava / Jurerê Internacional beach clubs; (b) opening: 'Excuse me, are you a model? You have a great look — our agency Mega Model is doing a campaign and we'd love to feature you'; (c) business card / Instagram handle exchanged with photo-shoot offer; (d) 'free accommodation in our model house in Praia Brava during the shoot week'; (e) 'flexible payment — cover your travel, free accommodation, R$2,000 day rate after Day 1'; (f) once at the 'model house', isolation, passport confiscation, and forced-prostitution / trafficking risk; (g) 'photoshoot' setting that requires 'beach swimwear' or 'lingerie' that escalates; (h) target demographic: solo female travelers, often digital-nomads / backpackers in 20s–30s, sometimes 60+ travelers' daughters during family holidays. Documented and Brazilian Federal Police anti-trafficking advisories.

For travelers — and any female travelers in your party: (1) Don't engage with 'modeling scouts' approaching at any Florianópolis beach — legitimate Brazilian modeling agencies do NOT scout on tourist beaches; they work via established casting calls; (2) the 'Mega Model' name specifically — refuse anyone claiming this affiliation; (3) firm 'não obrigada' and walk away — do not engage in conversation, do not accept business card, do not follow on Instagram; (4) 'free accommodation in model house' is a TRAFFICKING TEMPLATE — never accept; (5) for travelers with adult daughters / nieces in their party, brief them on this specific pattern before the trip; (6) Brazilian Federal Police anti-trafficking hotline: 100 (Disque 100) for any concerning approach; (7) Polícia Civil Florianópolis +55 48 3251 0202 for immediate threats; DEATUR +55 48 3271 6390; (8) US Consulate Rio (+55 21 3823 2000) coordinates with Brazilian authorities for trafficking concerns; (9) Florianópolis is broadly safe for 60+ tourists — this scam targets younger demographics, but family parties should be aware; (10) for legitimate Florianópolis beach experience without recruit-scam exposure, base in Centro or Lagoa da Conceição (less beach-club tourist density than Jurerê). NEVER engage with "modeling scouts" approaching at any Florianópolis beach — legitimate Brazilian agencies do NOT scout at tourist beaches; they work via established casting calls. Refuse "Mega Model" specifically (the named recurring 2025 brand). Firm "não obrigada" and walk away — no business card exchange, no Instagram follow. "Free accommodation in model house" is a TRAFFICKING TEMPLATE; never accept. Brief any female travelers in your party (especially adult daughters/nieces) before the trip. Brazilian Federal anti-trafficking hotline: 100 (Disque 100); Polícia Civil Florianópolis +55 48 3251 0202.
scams.avoidance: NEVER engage 'modelling scouts' on Floripa beaches (none are legitimate) Refuse 'Mega Model' brand specifically per 2025 community warning Firm 'não obrigada'; do not exchange Instagram or business card 'Free accommodation in model house' is a TRAFFICKING TEMPLATE Disque 100 (Federal anti-trafficking); DEATUR +55 48 3271 6390
scams.location: Praia Mole, Praia da Joaquina, Praia Brava, Jurerê Internacional beach club zone, Lagoa da Conceição evening promenade, summer-season tourist zones
scams.tldr: "Mega Model" beach-scout scammers approach female tourists 18–30 (and 60+ travelers' adult daughters) at Praia Mole, Praia Brava, and Jurerê Internacional with "agency campaign" and "free model house" pitches — actual trafficking and sexual-exploitation risk per Brazilian Federal Police anti-trafficking advisories.

scams.name: Florianópolis Beach Vendor & 'VIP Beach Club' Upcharge at Praia Mole / Jurerê
scams.description:
Florianópolis's premier beaches — Praia Mole, Joaquina, Jurerê Internacional — host a 2025 beach-club and walking-vendor ecosystem with VIP upcharge patterns common to Brazilian summer destinations.

The 2025 patterns: (a) Jurerê Internacional beach clubs (Café de la Musique, Donna Floripa, P12, Mood) — 'VIP couples bed R$1,500–R$3,500 per day' (standard chair + umbrella + service R$150–R$300 with R$200–R$400 food/drink minimum); (b) 'mandatory parking R$100' at Jurerê beach-club entrances (street parking is free 100 m away); (c) walking vendors with bracelets, sarongs, jewelry, henna tattoos, açaí cups at aggressive 'special price my friend' pitches — opening offer often 3–4× fair market; (d) 'açaí na tigela R$35' from walking vendor (real R$12–R$18 from licensed beach kiosks); (e) 'beach massage R$200/30 min' becoming R$600 'extended deluxe' (real reputable spa massage at hotel R$250–R$400 for 60 min); (f) 'jet-ski rental R$600/30 min' at Jurerê (comparison-shop 3 operators — fair R$200–R$350); (g) 'photo with Floripa flag / surfboard R$50' at tourist hot-spots; (h) 'private cabana R$1,800/day' at Jurerê Internacional (standard chair + umbrella R$200–R$400 covers same beach access).

For travelers: (1) all Brazilian beaches are PUBLIC federal property (Lei 7.661/1988) — no entrance fee, no chair-rental obligation; (2) reputable Jurerê beach clubs: Café de la Musique (Google 4.4+, transparent pricing R$150–R$300 chair + min spend), Donna Floripa (R$200–R$400 chair + min spend), P12 (the original, R$250–R$500); (3) Praia Mole is for surfers / younger crowd (waves, party scene); for TRAVELLERS' calm swimming, choose Jurerê (calm, family-friendly), Praia Daniela (north island, sheltered), Praia da Galheta (secluded, walkable from Mole), or Praia dos Ingleses (north island, calm shore); (4) Refuse every 'VIP couples bed', 'private cabana', 'exclusive zone' upsell above R$400 — standard chair + umbrella at reputable clubs is the same beach access; (5) firm 'não obrigado' to walking vendors; (6) açaí from licensed kiosks R$12–R$18 (refuse R$35 walking-vendor pricing); (7) for massage, book at hotel spa or Spa Costa Norte at R$250–R$400; (8) jet-ski / banana-boat: comparison-shop 3 operators on the beach — fair jet-ski R$200–R$350; (9) for travelers, the Lagoa da Conceição (saltwater lagoon in island center) offers calm swimming with restaurants — gentler than Atlantic-coast surf beaches. All Brazilian beaches are PUBLIC federal property (Lei 7.661/1988) — no entrance fee, no chair-rental obligation. Reputable Jurerê beach clubs (Café de la Musique, Donna Floripa, P12) charge R$150–R$500 chair + minimum-spend; refuse every "VIP couples bed" or "private cabana" upsell above R$400. For calm-swim travelers, choose Jurerê, Praia Daniela, Praia da Galheta, or Praia dos Ingleses (not Mole's surf-party scene). Buy açaí at licensed kiosks (R$12–R$18) and book massages at hotel spas (R$250–R$400 for 60 min) — never with walking vendors.
scams.avoidance: All Brazilian beaches are PUBLIC — no entrance fee mandatory Reputable Jurerê: Café de la Musique, Donna Floripa, P12 R$150–R$500 Travellers: Jurerê / Daniela / Galheta / Ingleses (calmer than Mole) REFUSE 'VIP bed' / 'private cabana' / 'exclusive zone' upsells Açaí at licensed kiosk R$12–R$18; massage at hotel spa R$250–R$400
scams.location: Praia Mole / Praia da Joaquina (east-island surf beaches), Jurerê Internacional beach-club strip (north island), Praia da Galheta, Lagoinha do Leste, Praia da Armação
scams.tldr: Jurerê Internacional beach clubs (Café de la Musique, Donna Floripa, P12) upcharge "VIP couples beds" at R$1,500–R$3,500/day (standard chair + umbrella R$150–R$300), demand "mandatory parking R$100" at free street-parking zones, and walking vendors push R$35 açaí (real R$12–R$18) and R$200 "beach massages" that escalate.

scams.name: Florianópolis Lagoa da Conceição Restaurant Couvert + Serviço Padding
scams.description:
Florianópolis's Lagoa da Conceição — the saltwater lagoon area at the island's center, and its main bohemian dining hub — hosts a 2025 restaurant couvert artístico plus serviço padding ecosystem common to Brazilian beach destinations, with Jurerê Open Shopping running 2–3× Centro prices for the same dishes.

The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Lagoa da Conceição waterfront restaurants with 'couvert artístico R$25–R$60 per person' for live music that's a single guitarist for 30 min (legitimate is R$10–R$20 disclosed BEFORE seating); (b) 'serviço 13–15%' instead of standard 10% (Brazilian Lei 13.419/2017 makes serviço OPTIONAL — you can refuse); (c) 'taxa de couvert + serviço' double-charging (illegal per PROCON SC); (d) Jurerê Open Shopping restaurants at 2–3× Centro prices for similar Brazilian dishes; (e) 'agua mineral R$18' (real R$5–R$10); (f) 'caipirinha de cachaça artesanal R$45' from house cachaça (real R$18–R$30); (g) 'sequência de camarão' (shrimp tasting) verbally quoted at R$200–R$400 per person without weight disclosed (real R$100–R$180); (h) bill-switcheroo where R$ amount on receipt differs from card by R$30–R$100; (i) Mercado Público (Centro) tourist-menu spots at 1.5–2× working-class fishmonger prices.

For travelers: (1) BEFORE sitting at any Lagoa / Centro / Jurerê restaurant, ASK for menu and CONFIRM (a) couvert artístico R$ amount per person (legitimate R$10–R$20), (b) serviço % policy (10% standard, OPTIONAL by Brazilian law), (c) credit-card surcharge — photograph the menu; (2) reputable Lagoa: Restaurante Pirão (Avenida das Rendeiras, traditional Açoriana, Google 4.6+, R$70–R$150), Aboriginie (Lagoa center, regional, R$80–R$180), Manolo Restaurante (Lagoa, Brazilian-Italian, R$90–R$200); (3) reputable Centro: Mercado Público (multiple stalls — Box 32 for local seafood, Restaurante Kaffa for traditional, R$50–R$120), Restaurante Ostradamus (Ribeirão da Ilha, oysters direct from farm, R$120–R$250); (4) 'serviço' is OPTIONAL by Brazilian Lei 13.419/2017 — tip 10% if happy, refuse if poor service or padded; (5) for water, order 'água sem gás copo' (free tap water) at most spots; (6) for caipirinha, expect R$18–R$30 at reputable Lagoa spots — anything above R$50 is tourist-trap pricing; (7) for shrimp, agree weight × R$80–R$150 per kg in writing BEFORE cooking (Florianópolis is famous for shrimp — but tourist-trap pricing is real). BEFORE sitting at any Lagoa, Centro, or Jurerê restaurant, ASK for the menu and CONFIRM (a) couvert artístico R$ amount per person (legit R$10–R$20), (b) serviço % policy (10% standard and OPTIONAL by Lei 13.419/2017), (c) credit-card surcharge — photograph the menu. Reputable Lagoa: Restaurante Pirão (Avenida das Rendeiras, R$70–R$150), Aboriginie, Manolo Restaurante. Reputable Centro: Mercado Público stalls (Box 32, Restaurante Kaffa) and Ostradamus oysters (Ribeirão da Ilha). For shrimp, agree weight × R$80–R$150/kg in writing BEFORE cooking. Refuse padded serviço under Brazilian law.
scams.avoidance: BEFORE sitting confirm couvert + serviço + card surcharge in writing Reputable Lagoa: Restaurante Pirão, Aboriginie, Manolo Restaurante Centro: Mercado Público stalls (Box 32, Kaffa); Ostradamus oysters 'Serviço' OPTIONAL (Lei 13.419/2017); refuse if poor service Caipirinha R$18–R$30 at reputable; >R$50 is tourist-trap
scams.location: Lagoa da Conceição restaurant strip (Avenida das Rendeiras / Servidão João Manoel Gonçalves), Centro Florianópolis Mercado Público restaurants, Praia Mole beachfront dining, Jurerê Open Shopping restaurants
scams.tldr: Lagoa da Conceição waterfront restaurants pad bills with R$25–R$60 "couvert artístico" for one-guitarist live music (legit R$10–R$20), 13–15% "serviço" (Lei 13.419/2017 makes it OPTIONAL), illegal couvert+serviço double-charging, and verbal "sequência de camarão R$200–R$400/person" without weight disclosed.

scams.name: Florianópolis North-Island Schooner Tour & 'Ilha do Campeche' Boat-Operator Scam
scams.description:
Florianópolis is an island (Ilha de Santa Catarina) with multiple boat-tour categories — north-island schooner beach-hopping (Canasvieiras-launched), Ilha do Campeche day-trip (Armação-launched), and lagoon kayak rentals. The 2025 boat-operator ecosystem hosts overcharge plus unlicensed-operator patterns, including documented serious safety issues during summer storm windows.

Legitimate cost: Canasvieiras schooner beach-hopping tour (5 hours, 3–4 north-island bay stops + lunch buffet + snorkel gear) is R$80–R$150 per person via reputable operators (Escuna Príncipe Negro, Escuna Trip Floripa). Ilha do Campeche day-trip via small boat from Praia da Armação is R$60–R$120 round-trip per person + R$25 island-conservation entry (mandatory). Lagoa da Conceição kayak rental R$30–R$60 per hour. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Canasvieiras pier-front touts selling 'private schooner R$600 per person' (group R$80–R$150); (b) 'VIP exclusive route to Praia do Forte R$400' — Forte is a standard schooner stop; (c) unlicensed boats without life jackets / VHF radio / Marinha registration — Florianópolis north coast has documented serious safety issues during summer storms; (d) Ilha do Campeche 'private speedboat R$500 per person' (real R$60–R$120); (e) 'Campeche island guide mandatory R$100' (no guide required — the island is a small public archaeological park with R$25 entry); (f) 'all-inclusive open bar premium R$250' (standard schooner + 2 extra beers); (g) 'private islands access R$300' to islands that are actually public; (h) Praia da Daniela 'banana boat for kids R$200' (real R$50–R$80 at licensed operators).

For travelers: (1) book Canasvieiras schooner tour ONLY through Google 4.5+ operators with at least 50 reviews: Escuna Príncipe Negro (Google 4.4+), Escuna Trip Floripa (Google 4.5+) at R$80–R$150 per person 5-hour tour; (2) VERIFY life jackets for every passenger BEFORE boarding; check Marinha (Brazilian Navy) registration sticker on the boat; (3) for Ilha do Campeche, book direct at Praia da Armação pier — small-boat operators charge R$60–R$120 round-trip; pay R$25 island-conservation entry on arrival; (4) Refuse every 'private schooner' / 'VIP exclusive' / 'private islands' upsell — most of Florianópolis's island-coast is public-access; (5) pre-book online 1–2 days ahead in high season (Dec–Mar); (6) Ilha do Campeche has limited daily visitor quota (300 people) — arrive at the Armação pier by 9 AM in peak season for boat availability; (7) bring biodegradable sunscreen ONLY (Campeche has protected coral); (8) for travelers with motion-sickness, take Dramamine 30 min before departure; (9) for travelers preferring CALMER experience, Lagoa da Conceição kayak rental (R$30–R$60/hour) is gentler than open-ocean schooner; (10) DEATUR Florianópolis +55 48 3271 6390 for any boat-tour incident. Book Canasvieiras schooner tours ONLY through Google 4.5+ operators with 50+ reviews — Escuna Príncipe Negro or Escuna Trip Floripa at R$80–R$150 per person for the 5-hour group tour. VERIFY life jackets for every passenger and the Marinha registration sticker BEFORE boarding. For Ilha do Campeche, book direct at Praia da Armação pier (R$60–R$120 round-trip + R$25 conservation entry; arrive by 9 AM for the 300-person daily quota). Refuse every "private schooner / VIP route / private islands" upsell — Florianópolis's island coast is mostly public-access. Bring biodegradable sunscreen for Campeche's protected coral; DEATUR +55 48 3271 6390 for any incident.
scams.avoidance: Book Google 4.5+: Escuna Príncipe Negro, Escuna Trip Floripa R$80–R$150 Verify life jackets + Marinha registration BEFORE boarding Ilha do Campeche: direct boat at Armação R$60–R$120 + R$25 entry REFUSE 'private' / 'VIP' / 'islands access' upsells Campeche quota 300/day — arrive Armação by 9 AM in peak season
scams.location: Canasvieiras pier (north-island schooner launches), Praia da Armação pier (Ilha do Campeche access), Praia da Daniela boat-rental zones, hotel-concierge boat-tour bookings
scams.tldr: Canasvieiras pier touts sell "private schooner R$600/person" trips (real Escuna Príncipe Negro / Trip Floripa group rate R$80–R$150) and "private speedboat to Ilha do Campeche R$500/person" (real R$60–R$120 + R$25 conservation entry); unlicensed boats lack life jackets and Marinha registration in summer-storm waters.
